title: docs(pm-dispatch): cloud-card lifecycle ends at archive_session — the missing paragraph
body:
## What

Adds one paragraph to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`'s `mode:cloud` section (after 监控与转向): **completed cloud cards are archived via `archive_session`** — with the two criteria (PR MERGED/closed + OS-DEV-REPORT collected and reviewed), the batch-sweep habit over `list_sessions`'s review_ready stock, and the hard boundary: ⛔ never archive before the PR merges, because a live completed session is the landing window's executor — a PM comment on the PR wakes it to run merge + full regen + re-push when the base goes dirty (two same-day precedents cited in the text: PR #7265's self-rebase, PR #7325's #7322-conflict union resolution).

The section previously covered create_session, monitoring, steering and collection, but said nothing about the lifecycle terminal state; the practice existed only as a maintainer chat instruction.

## Authorization (`.claude/` tooling-PR exception, Guardrails)

Per the PM-dispatch guardrail, a PM may implement a `.claude/` internal-tooling PR only on the maintainer's explicit authorization, quoted in the PR body. Maintainer instructions of 2026-08-10, verbatim and untranslated:

> 「spec 已完成的云卡片关掉,再看看有没有新任务可以批量派。」

> 「已完成的云卡片应该归档,项目经理skills 没写到吗」

The second message identifies precisely this skill gap; this PR closes it and nothing else (18 added lines, one file). Per the same guardrail this PR is **not** self-reviewed or self-merged: it stays draft for the maintainer (or another seat) to review and land.

## Scope check

- One file: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (+18/−0).
- No code, no `docs/adr/**`, no `content/docs/releases/`, no changeset (internal agent tooling under `.claude/`, not a published package — `skip-changeset` applies if the gate asks).
